fusions.name: Decoy Cart
fusions.desc: Rolls an empty decoy cart into the first enemy in its path. It deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and has a 50% chance to turn it against its allies for 3 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Dust in Their Eyes
fusions.desc: Spins your wheels to throw dust through a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 7 damage, with a 40% chance to leave each enemy [Blunted] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: False Trail
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds and moves you 25% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Already Down the Road
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, an attack that would hit you rolls your dodge a second time, and the second roll stands.
